description: This file defines the GeoZone class in the Opencart admin controller namespace, handling events related to geo zones such as adding, editing, and deleting geo zones, and scheduling related tasks.

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: Controller class managing geo zone events and scheduling related tasks in Opencart admin.

methods.name: addGeoZone
methods.description: Handles adding a new geo zone, schedules tasks to update tax rates and country info based on the new geo zone.

methods.name: editGeoZone
methods.description: Handles editing an existing geo zone, updates tax rate info, country info, and manages removal of outdated country data.

methods.name: deleteGeoZone
methods.description: Handles deleting a geo zone, schedules tasks to update tax rate info and country info for removed zones.
